race.comment: WINSTON'S PRIDE (8) is ticking along nicely without winning but has just been finding a few above average maiden winners. Lines up well again and gets a key booking in Toeroek. Can break through this time. MANDARIN (11) was left with quite the job to do when turning for home here last week and while she didn't threaten, she did warm into nicely late. Will appreciate the extra 200m and if she can settle closer she could take this out. FULLHEADOFSTEAM (2) was better last start at Naracoorte when holding on to third. At his top now and gets in well at the weights with the 2kg claimer engaged. Not dismissing. TEAR APART (7) showed good early speed last start before boxing on well and finishing third over this trip at Hamilton in a much improved effort. Nearing his peak now and should have enough early toe to offset the wide draw.
